confirmedCounterexamples.countQualification: Ten failing new leaf cases plus two failed aggregate parents; not twelve independent vulnerabilities.
mechanisms: During resolveKey/importKey, initial allowed sky fields plus a signature for later sky+zema fields pass the first policy check; mutation before signing-byte construction causes old code to return the later out-of-allowlist scope.
The resolver is called for issuer-1/key-1 but old code can verify and return later issuer-2/key-2 fields with a matching signature under the original key.
During verify the real WebCrypto call consumes the original bytes, but old code returns the caller object after its scope/signature changed.
Parent epoch, owner authentication, device revocation and scope withdrawal during awaited crypto are not rechecked by old code.
Mutating the input alias after success changes the old verified result.
The unchanged serviceAccessEvaluator product caller can return canDispatch=true after its passed device facts are revoked during resolveKey.

minimalFix.notParentDbFreshness: No DB read, parent entitlement refresh, budget consumption, issuer callback or Broker commit recheck is added or bypassed. A caller replacing a containing snapshot reference is outside this helper object reference.

minimalFix.inputMutationSemantics: For an already verified valid entry, caller mutation during verify can still yield the safe original detached snapshot. No requirement to return the later mutated object is preserved.
